# Field engineering handbook

Everything a visiting engineer needs, in the order they will need it.

# Before the visit

Confirm the site contact the day before.
- Charge both batteries.
- Print the site pass.

## Parts to carry
| Part | Quantity |
| --- | --- |
| Battery | 2 |
| Site pass | 1 |

# On site

Sign in at reception even when the door is open. Report the visit before you leave.
